seo.title: Best Fine Dining in Abu Dhabi (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Abu Dhabi's top 12 fine dining restaurants for 2026. From opulent Italian to sophisticated Japanese, find your next unforgettable culinary experience in the UAE capital.

hero.h1: 12 Best Fine Dining in Abu Dhabi
hero.subtitle: Abu Dhabi's fine dining scene is a dazzling tapestry of world-class cuisine, opulent settings, and impeccable service, reflecting the city's luxurious lifestyle and diverse international palate.
hero.badge: 🏆 Popular Picks — Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

picks.name: Hakkasan
picks.neighborhood: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Corniche Road
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Hakkasan delivers a sophisticated Cantonese experience within a sleek, dimly lit setting that exudes modern luxury. Known for its innovative approach to traditional dishes and a vibrant bar scene, it offers both intimacy and energy.
picks.whatToOrder: Signature Peking Duck with Kaluga caviar, or the Hakka Steamed Dim Sum Platter.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table in the outdoor terrace area during cooler months for stunning views and a more relaxed atmosphere.
picks.redditQuote: "Hakkasan at Emirates Palace is *the* place for a special night. Their Peking Duck is legendary, and the cocktails are on another level. Worth every dirham."

picks.name: Talea by Antonio Guida
picks.neighborhood: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Corniche Road
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Chef Antonio Guida brings his renowned culinary artistry to Abu Dhabi with Talea, offering "Cucina di Famiglia" – family-style Italian cooking elevated to fine dining. The restaurant boasts a bright, elegant ambiance with a focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients and authentic flavors.
picks.whatToOrder: The "Cacio e Pepe" prepared table-side, or any of their fresh pasta dishes.
picks.insiderTip: Ask for a table on the terrace overlooking the palace grounds for a truly romantic setting, especially at sunset.
picks.redditQuote: "Talea is an absolute gem. The Italian food is just incredible, so fresh and refined. Had the best pasta of my life there, truly an experience at Emirates Palace."

picks.name: Zuma
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Zuma offers a sophisticated take on the traditional Japanese Izakaya, with an elegant, multi-level dining space and an energetic atmosphere. Diners can enjoy expertly crafted sushi, sashimi, and robata-grilled dishes prepared in an open kitchen.
picks.whatToOrder: Black Cod marinated in Miso, or the Spicy Beef Tenderloin with sesame, red chili, and sweet soy.
picks.insiderTip: The bar area is vibrant and perfect for pre-dinner drinks; try their unique sake cocktails.
picks.redditQuote: "You can't go wrong with Zuma on Al Maryah. The Black Cod is famous for a reason, but honestly, everything on the menu is top-tier. Great place for a fancy night out."

picks.name: LPM Restaurant & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: LPM brings the chic Riviera experience to Abu Dhabi with its vibrant, airy interior and a menu celebrating the essence of French-Mediterranean cuisine. Known for its simple yet exquisite dishes designed for sharing, it offers a sophisticated yet lively atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Escargots with Garlic Butter, or the Whole Roasted Sea Bream with artichokes and cherry tomatoes.
picks.insiderTip: Start your meal with their complimentary plate of cherry tomatoes, lemon, and olive oil – it's a simple, delicious ritual.
picks.redditQuote: "LPM is always a good idea. The vibe is amazing, and their French-Mediterranean food is just so fresh and flavorful. Definitely get the Burrata!"

picks.name: Butcher & Still
picks.neighborhood: Al Maryah Island, Four Seasons Hotel
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Transport yourself to a 1920s Chicago steakhouse at Butcher & Still, renowned for its prime cuts of meat, classic sides, and prohibition-era cocktails. The opulent, dark wood interiors create an intimate and luxurious dining experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The 34oz Tomahawk Steak for sharing, or their famous Truffle Mac and Cheese.
picks.insiderTip: Save room for the "1920s Chocolate Cake," a towering dessert that's truly decadent.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want a proper steak in Abu Dhabi, Butcher & Still is it. Their cuts are fantastic, and the speakeasy vibe is so cool. Great date spot too."

picks.name: COYA
picks.neighborhood: Al Maryah Island, Four Seasons Hotel
picks.whyItMadeTheList: COYA offers a vibrant journey through Peruvian cuisine, blending traditional flavors with modern culinary techniques. The energetic atmosphere, stunning decor, and live music often create a memorable, celebratory dining experience.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their fresh Ceviche dishes, particularly the Lubina Clásica, or the Wagyu Beef Short Ribs.
picks.insiderTip: Don't miss the Pisco Bar for signature cocktails; their Pisco Sours are among the best in the city.
picks.redditQuote: "COYA is such a fun place! The Peruvian food is incredible, especially the ceviche, and the whole atmosphere is just electric. Always a good time."

picks.name: Fouquet's Abu Dhabi
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Helmed by legendary chef Pierre Gagnaire, Fouquet's offers a refined Parisian brasserie experience within the iconic Louvre Abu Dhabi. It combines classic French gastronomy with an elegant setting and breathtaking views of the museum and the sea.
picks.whatToOrder: Classic Steak Tartare, or the Dover Sole Meunière.
picks.insiderTip: Plan your visit to coincide with sunset to enjoy the stunning golden hour views over the water.
picks.redditQuote: "Fouquet's at the Louvre is a hidden gem for French food. The ambiance is so chic, and the food feels authentically Parisian. Great way to end a museum day."

picks.name: Oak Room
picks.neighborhood: Al Bateen, The Abu Dhabi EDITION
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tom Aikens' Oak Room is a contemporary British steakhouse known for its premium cuts of meat, sophisticated preparation, and a chic, modern design. The focus is on quality ingredients, a curated wine list, and a relaxed yet refined dining atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: The signature Wagyu striploin, or the Lobster Thermidor.
picks.insiderTip: Check out their Saturday Roast for a truly indulgent and value-packed weekend experience, a unique offering for a fine dining steakhouse.
picks.redditQuote: "Oak Room is my go-to for steak now. The meat quality is insane, and the service at The EDITION is always top-notch. Their truffle mash is a must-try."

picks.name: Li Beirut
picks.neighborhood: Jumeirah at Etihad Towers, Corniche Road
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Li Beirut offers an authentic and elevated Lebanese dining experience with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. The menu features classic dishes prepared with fresh ingredients and a contemporary touch, served in an elegant, traditional setting.
picks.whatToOrder: The Makanek (spicy sausages), or the Lamb Shank Fatteh.
picks.insiderTip: Request a table by the window to enjoy panoramic views of the Corniche and the Presidential Palace.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want real high-end Lebanese food, Li Beirut at Etihad Towers is it. The views are incredible, and their mezze platters are just divine. So fresh."

picks.name: 99 Sushi Bar & Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Originating from Spain, 99 Sushi Bar brings an innovative and luxurious Japanese dining experience to Abu Dhabi. Renowned for its exceptional quality sushi and sashimi, signature hot dishes, and a sophisticated, dark-hued ambiance perfect for a special occasion.
picks.whatToOrder: The Toro Tartar with caviar, or the 99 Spicy Tuna maki.
picks.insiderTip: Their business lunch is an excellent way to experience their high-quality offerings at a more accessible price point.
picks.redditQuote: "99 Sushi Bar is seriously underrated. The sushi is unbelievably fresh, and their tempura is out of this world. Definitely a step above most Japanese places."

picks.name: Dai Pai Dong
picks.neighborhood: Al Maryah Island, Rosewood Abu Dhabi
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Dai Pai Dong recreates the lively atmosphere of a traditional Hong Kong street food market, but in a sophisticated fine dining setting. Specializing in authentic Cantonese cuisine, it's particularly famous for its handcrafted dim sum and flavorful roasted meats.
picks.whatToOrder: Assorted Dim Sum Basket, or the Peking Duck.
picks.insiderTip: Their unlimited dim sum brunch on weekends is a fantastic way to sample a wide array of their best offerings.
picks.redditQuote: "Dai Pai Dong at Rosewood has the best dim sum in the city, hands down. It's proper Cantonese, and the ambiance is really cool without being stuffy."

picks.name: Finz
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Finz offers an exquisite seafood dining experience right on the water's edge, boasting stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and the city skyline. The menu emphasizes fresh, sustainably sourced seafood prepared with Mediterranean flair in an elegant, romantic setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Fresh Catch of the Day, grilled to perfection, or the Seafood Platter.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table on the outdoor deck to fully appreciate the sea breeze and the beautiful Abu Dhabi sunset.
picks.redditQuote: "Finz is my go-to for seafood. The location is beautiful right on the water, and their fresh catch is always perfectly cooked. Great for a romantic dinner."

faq.question: What is the typical dress code for fine dining restaurants in Abu Dhabi?
faq.answer: Most fine dining establishments in Abu Dhabi enforce a smart casual or elegant dress code. For men, this usually means collared shirts, smart trousers, and closed shoes; jackets may be preferred in some venues. For women, elegant dresses, skirts, or smart trousers are appropriate. Avoid beachwear, shorts, flip-flops, or athletic attire.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for fine dining in Abu Dhabi?
faq.answer: Yes, reservations are highly recommended, especially for popular venues, weekend evenings, or if you have specific seating requests. Many top restaurants can be booked weeks in advance. Using online booking platforms or calling directly ensures you secure your preferred time.

faq.question: What is the average cost of a fine dining meal in Abu Dhabi?
faq.answer: The average cost for a fine dining experience in Abu Dhabi typically ranges from AED 350-800 per person (approximately $95-220 USD), excluding alcoholic beverages. This price can vary significantly depending on the venue, number of courses, and whether you opt for premium ingredients or extensive wine pairings.

faq.question: Are alcoholic beverages served in fine dining restaurants in Abu Dhabi?
faq.answer: Yes, most fine dining restaurants located within hotels or licensed standalone establishments in Abu Dhabi do serve a full range of alcoholic beverages, including wines, spirits, and cocktails. These menus often feature extensive and curated selections to complement the cuisine.

faq.question: Are there vegetarian or vegan options available at fine dining restaurants?
faq.answer: Many fine dining restaurants in Abu Dhabi are increasingly accommodating to vegetarian and vegan diets. While dedicated menus may not always be standard, chefs are often willing to adapt dishes or create bespoke options upon request. It's best to inform the restaurant of your dietary preferences when making a reservation.

faq.question: What's the best fine dining experience for a special occasion like an anniversary?
faq.answer: For a special occasion, consider venues known for their exceptional ambiance and service. Talea by Antonio Guida for a romantic Italian evening, Hakkasan for sophisticated Chinese glamour, or Finz for stunning waterfront views and fresh seafood are all excellent choices that promise a memorable celebration.

methodology: Our selection process meticulously combined expert culinary reviews, extensive local insights, and guest satisfaction ratings. We focused on establishments demonstrating consistent excellence in food quality, innovative menus, service standards, and unique ambiance, ensuring a truly exceptional dining experience.
